AMERICAN.notesEn: Minimum B or 85% in Grade 12 or the best two of Grades 10 to 12. SAT Math 450 is mandatory.
AMERICAN.notesAr: الحد الأدنى B أو 85% في الصف الثاني عشر أو في أفضل سنتين من الصفوف 10 إلى 12. اختبار SAT رياضيات بدرجة 450 إلزامي.
AMERICAN.quote: Applicants must attain a minimum of B or 85% average in the final grade (Grade 12) or the average of the best two years of grades 10, 11, and 12.

BRITISH.notesEn: Five IGCSE/GCSE subjects at grade 5 or B, plus three AS-levels or two A-levels at grade B minimum; Year 13 must be completed. Arabic and Islamic Education do not count.
BRITISH.notesAr: خمس مواد IGCSE/GCSE بدرجة 5 أو B، إضافة إلى ثلاث مواد AS أو مادتين A-level بدرجة B على الأقل، مع إتمام الصف الثالث عشر. لا تُحتسب اللغة العربية والتربية الإسلامية.
BRITISH.quote: Applicants must have five IGCSE/GCSE (O-Level) subjects with a minimum grade of 5 or B in each subject, and either three AS-Level subjects, or two A-level subjects with a minimum grade of B in each subject.

IB.notesEn: Full IB Diploma with six subjects (excluding Islamic Education), at least three at Higher Level.
IB.notesAr: دبلوم البكالوريا الدولية الكامل بست مواد (باستثناء التربية الإسلامية)، ثلاث منها على الأقل بالمستوى العالي.
IB.quote: Applicants must be awarded the full IB Diploma with six subjects (excluding Islamic Education) with at least three in the higher level, and attain a minimum score of 24 points.

CBSE.quote: Applicants must attain a minimum of 65% or more in the Senior Secondary School Certificate (12th Standard), or 65% or more in the best two years.

ISC.notesEn: The page lists Indian Board Curriculum (CBSE, ICSE, State Board).
ISC.notesAr: تذكر الصفحة مناهج المجالس الهندية (CBSE وICSE ومجالس الولايات).
ISC.quote: Applicants must attain a minimum of 65% or more in the Senior Secondary School Certificate (12th Standard), or 65% or more in the best two years.

UAE_MOE.notesEn: General Secondary Curriculum (Thanaweya Ammah and Applied Technology). Higher averages apply for certain majors and streams (General, Advanced, Elite).
UAE_MOE.notesAr: منهج الثانوية العامة (الثانوية العامة والتكنولوجيا التطبيقية). تُشترط معدلات أعلى لبعض التخصصات والمسارات (العام والمتقدم والنخبة).
UAE_MOE.quote: General Secondary Curriculum (Thanaweya Ammah and Applied Technology) Applicants must attain a minimum average of 85% in the best two years of secondary education or 85% in the final public examination.

SABIS.notesAr: يُشترط أيضا اختبار SAT رياضيات بدرجة 450.
SABIS.quote: SABIS® Applicants must attain a minimum of B or 75% average in the final grade (Grade 12) or the average of the best two years of grades 10, 11, and 12.
